## PR Checklist

- [ ] My code follows the repository's style and formatting guidelines (`cargo fmt`, `pnpm lint`).
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my code.
- [ ] I have commented my code, particularly in hard-to-understand areas.
- [ ] I have added tests that prove my fix is effective or that my feature works (`cargo test`, `pnpm typecheck`).
- [ ] New and existing tests pass locally with my changes.
- [ ] I have made corresponding changes to the documentation where needed.
- [ ] My changes generate no new warnings or lint errors.
- [ ] Any dependent changes have been merged and published in downstream modules.
